unnest_keep_parent_names.sql: SELECT unnest([{'a': 0, 'b': {'bb': 1}}], recursive := true, keep_parent_names := true);

columns_expression.sql: UNPIVOT t ON COLUMNS(* EXCLUDE (empid, dept)) INTO NAME month VALUE sales;

in_cte.sql: WITH u AS (UNPIVOT t ON COLUMNS(* EXCLUDE (empid, dept)) INTO NAME month VALUE sales) SELECT * FROM u;

in_subquery.sql: SELECT * FROM (UNPIVOT t ON jan, feb INTO NAME month VALUE sales) u;

manual.sql: UNPIVOT t ON jan, feb, mar INTO NAME month VALUE sales;

multiple_value_columns.sql: UNPIVOT t ON (jan, feb, mar) AS q1, (apr, may, jun) AS q2 INTO NAME quarter VALUE m1, m2, m3;

on_only.sql: UNPIVOT t ON jan, feb, mar;

order_by_limit.sql: UNPIVOT t ON jan, feb INTO NAME month VALUE sales ORDER BY month LIMIT 10;

pivot_longer.sql: PIVOT_LONGER t ON jan, feb, mar INTO NAME month VALUE sales;

standard.sql: FROM t UNPIVOT (sales FOR month IN (jan, feb, mar, apr, may, jun));

standard_columns.sql: FROM t UNPIVOT (sales FOR month IN (columns(* EXCLUDE (empid, dept))));

standard_include_nulls.sql: FROM t UNPIVOT INCLUDE NULLS (sales FOR month IN (jan, feb, mar));

standard_multiple_values.sql: FROM t UNPIVOT ((m1, m2, m3) FOR quarter IN ((jan, feb, mar) AS q1, (apr, may, jun) AS q2));

standard_select.sql: SELECT * FROM t UNPIVOT (sales FOR month IN (jan, feb, mar));

subquery_source_expressions.sql: UNPIVOT (SELECT 42 AS col1, 'woot' AS col2) ON (col1 * 2)::VARCHAR, col2;

alias_as.sql: UPDATE t AS x SET v = 1 WHERE x.k = 2;

alias_no_as.sql: UPDATE t x SET v = 1 WHERE x.k = 2;

expression.sql: UPDATE t SET revenue = revenue + 100 WHERE code = 'FR';

from.sql: UPDATE o SET v = n.v FROM n WHERE o.k = n.k;

from_multiple.sql: UPDATE o SET v = n.v FROM n, m WHERE o.k = n.k AND n.k = m.k;

scalar_subquery.sql: UPDATE o SET v = (SELECT n.v FROM n WHERE o.k = n.k);

where.sql: UPDATE t SET i = 0 WHERE i IS NULL;

ctas_values.sql: CREATE TABLE t AS SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('Amsterdam', 1), ('London', 2)) c(name, id);

ilike.sql: SELECT * FROM t WHERE name ILIKE '%mark%';

like.sql: SELECT * FROM t WHERE name LIKE '%mark%';

or.sql: SELECT * FROM t WHERE id = 3 OR id = 7;

base_window.sql: SELECT sum(c) OVER w2 FROM t WINDOW w1 AS (PARTITION BY a), w2 AS (w1 ORDER BY b);

multiple_windows.sql: SELECT sum(c) OVER w1, rank() OVER w2 FROM t WINDOW w1 AS (ORDER BY a), w2 AS (PARTITION BY b ORDER BY a);

named_window.sql: SELECT sum(c) OVER w FROM t WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY a ORDER BY b);

over_base_window_parens.sql: SELECT sum(c) OVER (w ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM t WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY a);

window_with_frame.sql: SELECT sum(c) OVER w FROM t WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY a ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING);

basic.sql: WITH cte AS (SELECT 42 AS x) SELECT * FROM cte;

column_list.sql: WITH cte(j) AS (SELECT 42 AS i) SELECT * FROM cte;

from_first_body.sql: WITH cte(j) AS (SELECT 42 AS i) FROM cte;

materialized.sql: WITH c(x) AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT 1) SELECT * FROM c AS c1, c AS c2;

multiple.sql: WITH c1 AS (SELECT 42 AS i), c2 AS (SELECT i * 100 AS x FROM c1) SELECT * FROM c2;

not_materialized.sql: WITH c(x) AS NOT MATERIALIZED (SELECT 1) SELECT * FROM c AS c1, c AS c2;

recursive.sql: WITH RECURSIVE c(i) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT i + 1 FROM c WHERE i < 5) SELECT * FROM c;

recursive_recurring.sql: WITH RECURSIVE c(i) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT i + 1 FROM c WHERE (SELECT max(i) FROM recurring.c) < 5) SELECT * FROM c;

recursive_using_key.sql: WITH RECURSIVE c(a, b) USING KEY (a) AS (SELECT 1, 3 UNION ALL SELECT a + 1, b FROM c WHERE a < 3) SELECT * FROM c;

recursive_using_key_values.sql: WITH RECURSIVE c(a, b) USING KEY (a) AS (VALUES (1, 3), (2, 4) UNION ALL SELECT a + 1, b FROM c WHERE a < 3) SELECT * FROM c;

table_body.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT 1 AS id) TABLE c ORDER BY id;
